title: Chapter 129: Underground Ratman
content:
Chapter 129: Underground Ratman

The Zerg biodegradation liquid, which is more terrible than the corrosive slime of the giant ghoul, has a terrifying area-killing effect on enemies with weak defense and resistance.

When ordinary creatures are sprayed with this biodegradation liquid, it will melt directly like wax encountering fire!

If a large number of hydralisks launch this attack at the same time, the scene can be imagined, it will be very terrifying!

The only weakness of the hydralisk may be that the amount of biodegradation liquid sprayed at one time cannot be compared with the giant ghoul. The reserve of biodegradation liquid is limited, and regeneration requires time and energy.

But this is also relative. The biodegradation liquid stored in the Zerg hydralisk is enough to deal with a conventional war when fighting in the spitting mode.

GOOGLE search TWKAN

The tested hydralisk perfectly demonstrated its new ability in front of Wu Qing. The spikes wrapped in the Zerg biodegradation liquid allow ordinary hydralisks to penetrate super thick armor defense targets.

Large swathes of scattered Zerg biodegradation fluid sprayed out, corroding the target area beyond recognition. If the target was an enemy, the enemy would be instantly turned into a pool of blood.

In this spray mode, the Hydralisk can control the spraying state of the biodegradation fluid, and can spray in different forms such as flakes, clumps, and dots to meet the combat needs in complex situations.

After a lot of tests, Wu Qing and the Queen of the Zerg were very satisfied with the performance of the test Hydralisk, and this test was a complete success.

Next, Wu Qing and the Queen of the Zerg conducted an evolution test on an air defense tower and found that the attack mode changes of the evolved air defense tower were exactly the same as those of the Hydralisk.

It’s just that the air defense tower is a defensive building, and its size is not comparable to that of the Hydralisk. It has greater attack power in various modes, longer shooting distance, and stronger sustainable attack capability.

The tests on the two Zerg units went smoothly, and this research mission was completed.

This new technology was added to buildings such as the Hydralisk nest in the form of an evolutionary skill. The Queen of the Zerg called this evolutionary skill Splash Decomposition.

Wu Qing upgraded the splash decomposition by consuming resources, and all hydralisks and air defense towers automatically evolved the attack capability of splash decomposition.

This is the same as upgrading the attack and defense in the evolution chamber building, which is an improvement for the entire Zerg.

With the splash decomposition attack capability, the Zerg's hydralisks and defensive building air defense towers can choose an attack mode according to the specific situation of the enemy, and the targeting and attack efficiency of the attack will be improved, which can greatly enhance the Zerg's long-range attack capability.

They cooperate with each other and use different attack modes to launch attacks at the same time. In many cases, they can also play a one plus one effect that is far greater than two.

…

After Wu Qing upgraded the hydralisks and air defense towers, he upgraded all the newly built defense buildings in the underground base and cave base of the Zerg territory to one star.

Divide the 12,000 hydralisks into two parts, stationed in the underground base and cave base of the Zerg territory respectively.

Of the nearly 100,000 Zerg puppies that entered the underground, 60,000 were stationed in the cave base, and 40,000 were stationed in the underground base of the Zerg territory.

Tonight, Wu Qing's preset battlefield is the newly built cave base, but those mysterious weirdos and ghouls may not play by the rules.

As night falls, everything is ready in the Zerg territory.

Next to each mother nest, Zerg puppies emerge from their cocoons in pairs from time to time, happily rushing to the defensive positions.

The hosts patrolled along the edge of the territory continuously, and all the one-star hosts went underground, monitoring the movements in the soil and rocks at the edge of the underground base and cave base in the Zerg territory.

The weird digging ability that helped the ghouls dig holes last night was really terrifying. If you don't keep an eye on it, they can dig the outside beyond recognition in a short time.

Without letting Wu Qing wait any longer, the one-star host patrolling the cave base discovered the movement.

Through the perception ability of the one-star host, Wu Qing discovered that it seemed that it was not a ghoul that appeared this time, but another strange creature with a smaller body.

When the first strange creature that was smaller than a goblin walked out of the passage, Wu Qing finally saw their full appearance. They were big rats that could walk upright!

But these big rats are different from the rat people. The rat people have the characteristics of rats in their heads, and the rest of the rats are basically human-shaped.

At first glance, these underground rats look a bit human-shaped, but if you look closely, they are almost all rat-like.

They have a mouth full of sharp teeth and four sharp claws, so people dare not underestimate their attack ability just because they are small.

"Rat people living in the underground world? Underground rat people?"

"I wonder what special abilities these underground rat people have that are worth those weirdos bringing them here?"

Wu Qing felt that these underground rat people were a race living in the underground world, and their ability to come out was still related to the weirdos that brought out the ghouls.

These underground rat people rushed out of the passage and rushed towards the Zerg territory. Wu Qing could see from their charge that these underground rat people were faster and more agile than the ghouls.

When they rushed to the attack range of the defensive spikes, spikes quickly stabbed out from under them. What surprised Wu Qing was that nearly half of the underground rats jumped up at the moment the spikes stabbed out and flexibly avoided the attack of the spikes!

"Strong perception ability! Plus small and agile skills! There is such a high probability of avoiding the attack of the spikes!"

Wu Qing saw the advantages of the underground rats.

Those underground ratmen pierced by the spikes, because of their small and light bodies, suffered less damage than the ghouls, and not many of them actually died and turned into light and disappeared.

A few hydralisks tried to attack with spikes and found that the underground ratmen who rushed up also had a certain chance to dodge the high-speed spikes.

"This is a bit interesting. Is this a race specially selected for the weaknesses of the Zerg?"

Wu Qing looked at the performance of the underground ratmen and couldn't help laughing.

That unknown weird vision is really good. Using underground ratmen to replace ghouls to attack the defense of the Zerg territory is more efficient from the current situation.

But it doesn't know that the Zerg has also made great progress in this day.

After a simple test attack, a large number of underground ratmen rushed out from various channels. Their small bodies ran and jumped flexibly. From a distance, they looked like a group of terrible insects, a dense mass.

"It is more appropriate to use Zerg to deal with the Zerg. Unfortunately, the Zerg in this world can be controlled by the host."

In terms of numbers and adaptability, Zerg are more suitable. Since the Zerg controlled a wave of Zerg, no Zerg enemies have appeared near the Zerg territory.
